# Fuel evaporation

Used in [Fuel](/rules/logistics/10-fuel).

## Table

| Id | Percent | When | Applies to | Rounding | Replaces |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| standard | 6 | stores expenditure stage | <span class="wrap">both sides, all fuel on the map (not in convoys at sea)</span> | down | — |
| hot weather | 5 | hot weather determined | <span class="wrap">both sides, each operations stage with hot weather, in addition; not fuel in units' own tanks (R-040)</span> | down | — |
| commonwealth-1940-41 | 9 | stores expenditure stage | <span class="wrap">Commonwealth, September 1940 to August 1941 inclusive</span> | down | standard |

## Notes

- Fuel evaporation and spillage rates (rules/logistics/10-fuel.md). Printed only in the rules text of 49.3, not as a separate chart; per the plan, the source .adoc transcription is the second reading. Scan (jp2 66) and .adoc agree: 0 of 3 rates differ
- R-042 (accepted): the 9% Commonwealth rate replaces the 6% (the 'replaces' field); the hot-weather 5% applies to both sides on top, is the same loss as 29.34 (taken once), rounds down, and does not reach convoys at sea
- Fuel in vehicles' own tanks: the standard (and Commonwealth) rate applies to it, the hot-weather rate does not (R-040, accepted; 29.34 excludes tank fuel from the hot-weather loss)
- Fuel in convoys at sea is exempt from the stores-expenditure-stage rate as printed, and from the hot-weather rate under R-042
- The Commonwealth period runs from September 1940 through the last game-turn of August 1941, inclusive
